title: TrailEntry
description: One served query, as a consumer recorded it: one line of `trail.jsonl`. Every field but `at` and `query` is optional, since consumers vary in how much they log.

at.description: RFC 3339 UTC time the query was served.

cited.description: Page ids (`<source>::<path>`) the consumer says were actually cited or used.

outcome.description: How the response fared, when the consumer recorded it.

ranks.description: Rank shown to the user for each entry of `retrieved` (same length, when given).

retrieved.description: Page ids (`<source>::<path>`) returned, in retrieval order.

session.description: An opaque session identifier, when the consumer gave one.

Outcome.description: What the consumer recorded happened with the response, when it recorded anything.

oneOf.description: Not recorded, or recorded as unknown.
